query: with lessons_target as (select s.name as series,l.id,l.title,l.is_active,coalesce(length(l.content),0) as content_length from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Histoire-Géographie' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2','C','D') and ((c.title='THÈME 2 — LA CORÉE DU SUD : UN EXEMPLE DE PAYS ÉMERGENT' and l.title='Leçon 1 — Les fondements du développement économique de la Corée du Sud') or (c.title='THÈME 3 — REGROUPEMENT ET COOPÉRATION ÉCONOMIQUE' and l.title in ('Leçon 1 — La CEDEAO : une organisation régionale à caractère économique','Leçon 2 — Les relations UE/ACP : un exemple de coopération Nord-Sud')))), lesson_counts as (select series,title,is_active,content_length,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=lessons_target.id) as exercise_count,(select count(*) from public.exercise_questions eq join public.exercises e on e.id=eq.exercise_id where e.lesson_id=lessons_target.id) as exercise_question_count,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=lessons_target.id) as quiz_count,(select count(*) from public.quiz_questions qq join public.quizzes q on q.id=qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id=lessons_target.id) as quiz_question_count,(select count(*) from public.quiz_answers qa join public.quiz_questions qq on qq.id=qa.question_id join public.quizzes q on q.id=qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id=lessons_target.id) as quiz_answer_count,(select bool_and(not e.is_active and not e.is_published) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=lessons_target.id) as exercises_draft,(select bool_and(not q.is_active and not q.is_published) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=lessons_target.id) as quizzes_draft from lessons_target), citation_counts as (select sub.name as subject_name,count(distinct c.id) as draft_count,bool_and(not c.is_active and not c.is_validated) as drafts_only,count(distinct cs.id) as scope_count,count(distinct ct.id) as theme_count from public.citations c join public.subjects sub on sub.id=c.subject_id left join public.citation_scopes cs on cs.citation_id=c.id left join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where (sub.name='Français' and c.source_title='Tartuffe ou l’Imposteur') or (sub.name='Philosophie' and c.source_title='Pensées') or (sub.name='Histoire-Géographie' and c.source_title='Charte des Nations Unies') or (sub.name='Physique-Chimie' and c.source_title='Traité élémentaire de chimie') group by sub.name) select jsonb_build_object('lessons',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(lesson_counts) order by series,title) from lesson_counts),'citations',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(citation_counts) order by subject_name) from citation_counts)) as verification limit 1;
